args:
import json
r=json.load(open('h:/Common/Projects/Personal/Software/YTMfever/Code/batch20_metadata_audit.json', encoding='utf-8'))
bad=[x for x in r['results'] if x['checks'].get('artist_matches_folder') is False or x['checks'].get('album_matches_folder') is False or x['checks'].get('genre_matches_ytmusic') is False]
print('MISMATCH_COUNT', len(bad))
for x in bad:
    print(x['file'])
    print(' artist_ok=', x['checks'].get('artist_matches_folder'), ' album_ok=', x['checks'].get('album_matches_folder'), ' genre_ok=', x['checks'].get('genre_matches_ytmusic'))
    print(' tags=', x['tags'])

tasks.label: check-new-tags
args:
from pathlib import Path
from mutagen.id3 import ID3
p=Path('h:/Common/Projects/Personal/Software/YTMfever/Code/JellyfinMusic/John Roseboro/Four Cantos')
files=sorted([x for x in p.glob('*.mp3')], key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
print('FILES', len(files))
for f in files[:3]:
    t=ID3(str(f))
    a=t.get('TPE1'); al=t.get('TALB'); ti=t.get('TIT2')
    print(f.name)
    print(' artist=', a.text[0] if a and a.text else None)
    print(' album=', al.text[0] if al and al.text else None)
    print(' title=', ti.text[0] if ti and ti.text else None)
